# Alawi AlAlawi

> Digitalization Manager at BMW Group KSA, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Fourteen years in automotive
> retail, working the seam where dealer management systems, customer data platforms, contact
> center operations and OEM retail standards have to agree on one customer record. Launched
> Noor, the AI customer-engagement agent live on the BMW and MINI Saudi Arabia websites since
> 7 July 2026 and on WhatsApp since 8 August 2026.

## Firsts

- Leading importer in the GCC running agentic AI across website widget, WhatsApp, Facebook and Instagram as a unified omnichannel experience. The agent, Noor, serves live new-car stock with options detail, exterior and interior imagery, installment plans and offers, test-drive requests, service-appointment booking, general requests and complaint capture, in Arabic and English.
- First marketing automation engine in Saudi Arabia built on SAP Customer Data Platform and SAP Emarsys Customer Engagement.
- Recognized by Jaguar Land Rover MENAP, December 2014, as among the first importers in the region to complete its CRM data integration.

## Credentials

- CFA Program Level I, CFA Institute, June 2019 - top 10th percentile.
- BSc Business Informatics, AMA International University Bahrain, 2011.

Canonical entity: https://alalawialawi.github.io/Resume/#person
